item.title: billy woods and Mickey Diamond Take a Bite Out of "Peter and the Wolf" » PopMatters
item.description: This is the story of an escape: billy woods, Mickey Diamond and the hip-hop fairytale that underground rap needed.

item.title: Star Trek's Ultimate, Absolute, Inarguably Final Frontier » PopMatters
item.description: In the minds of Star Trek's many creators, the "sky" is the limit(less), but been there, done that. So what's left for our adventurous mythmakers to explore?

item.title: The Stone Roses, Experience and Memory » PopMatters
item.description: The Stone Roses' songs remain capable of summoning emotions of extraordinary power. You can dance all night, hold the future in your arms, and drink from the well of youth.

item.title: Nicole Saphos Rocks With Determination » PopMatters
item.description: Nicole Saphos' music grapples with heavy emotions and the buzz of nostalgia, yet never seems derivative. Her songs are fresh, unique, and able to walk through fire.

item.title: Jon Irabagon and Quartet Brilliantly Go in Every Direction » PopMatters
item.description: As a composer and bandleader, Jon Irabagon wants to open your ears to styles co-mingling. His heart as a musician is big enough to feel and do it all.

item.title: 'My Word Against Mine' Turns Fracture into Procedure » PopMatters
item.description: Psychoanalysis documentary One Word Against Mine relies on that unstable border between what seems to come from outside and what has already taken shape within.

item.title: Robyn Is Doing Herself on 'Sexistential' » PopMatters
item.description: Sexistential embodies the contradiction in Robyn herself at this juncture in her career: she's the blueprint, so she refers to herself as such.

item.title: 'A Man and a Woman' and a Dizzy 1960s Romance » PopMatters
item.description: Claude Lelouch's hugely popular A Man and a Woman was criticized for its sleek, chic, starstruck, pie-eyed, romantic wish fulfillment. Yet therein lay its radicalism.

item.title: Kula Shaker's Crispian Mills Discusses the Creative Life » PopMatters
item.description: From physical media to ruminations on consciousness and what everyone is ultimately after, Crispian Mills answers questions like "Who are Kula Shaker?"

item.title: Edmund White's Longing for Being and Nothingness » PopMatters
item.description: The sexual world in Edmund White's The Beautiful Room Is Empty expresses the tension between being and nothingness: the body insists on presence, yet the self remains elusive.
